rationale: Review started 2026-11-25T01:20:29Z and ended 2026-11-25T01:25:02Z. All cited held texts were re-hashed (every source_fingerprints file and every evidence record's text_path matched its pinned sha256) and every record's text equals its file slice at char_start:char_end. Read the held original (55 FR 5953) in full: Executive Order 12701 of February 14, 1990, Amending Executive Order No. 12334; the OCR shows "THE WHITE HOUSE, February 14, 1990" without a legible signature name, so the signatory is attributed by date only; number, date, citation and subject match the OFR metadata. Its single operative sentence deletes the second sentence of section 1 of EO 12334 and inserts "One member shall be designated by the President as Chairman." The basis OWN_TEXT:EO:12701#700 re-derives it as a strike-and-insert amendment spent on issue, effective 1990-02-14, and the order has no other command. EO 12863 Sec. 3.3 (held FR text and the APP mirror in ACT:EO:12701>EO:12863 / PARENT_END) revokes EO 12334 "as amended" on 1993-09-13 without naming EO 12701; the producer correctly treats that only as the end of the surviving inserted sentence, not of this order. The single OFR observation ("Amends: EO 12334") shows no later event; no history flags; cruden found only the order's own text; no earlier end is possible and no revival exists. Status no is supported.
